name: Gløgg
description: Red wine warmed with brown-sugar-cinnamon syrup and orange, fortified with aquavit. The Scandinavian Christmas mulled wine.
history: Mulled wine is drunk across Northern Europe at Christmas; in Norway and Sweden it is gløgg or glögg, often fortified with aquavit or brandy. This quick version uses the house cinnamon syrup in place of whole spices.
whyItWorks: Aquavit’s caraway and dill read as the spice cabinet; the syrup sweetens and adds cinnamon; orange brightens the wine.
steps: Warm the wine, syrup and orange juice in a pan until steaming. Don’t let it boil.
Take it off the heat and stir in the aquavit.
Ladle into a warm mug and add an orange peel.
techniqueNotes: Scales to a pot easily; keep it on the lowest heat once warm.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Norwegian aquavit, as in Norwegian gløgg.
